title: Target taps Lowe’s executive as first chief AI officer
excerpt: For Chandhu Nair, collaboration will be essential as the retailer focuses on how technology can elevate user experience.
content_html:
Nicole Laskowski

Tue, August 11, 2026 at 10:47 AM CDT 3 min read

This story was originally published on CIO Dive. To receive daily news and insights, subscribe to our free daily CIO Dive newsletter.

Dive Brief:

  • Target appointed Chandhu Nair as its first chief AI officer and SVP, the company said Tuesday. Nair will join the company Aug. 24 after spending more than six years at Lowe's, most recently as SVP of stores, data, AI and innovation.

  • The retailer also promoted Purvi Shah as SVP of user experience, emphasizing in a statement that a close knit relationship between AI and UX technologies will help it "move from insight to action faster, while keeping people at the center of what we build." Both Nair and Shah will report to Prat Vemana, chief information and product officer, the company said in an email.

  • The executive changes reflect CEO Michael Fiddelke's multiyear turnaround strategy introduced in March to reverse slowing sales. The plan, which included an incremental $2 billion in operational and capital investments in 2026, attempts to revive growth, modernize customer experience and sharpen its brand identity. 

Dive Insight:

Target is making AI part of its C-suite, an indication of just how critical the technology is to its operational strategy. 

While it attached a broad remit to the new role, tasking Nair with "bringing greater focus and coordination to AI across the enterprise," the company also zeroed in on a concrete use case: how AI can bolster UX.

The coupling enables Target to flip the enterprise script on implementing AI at a time when companies are still struggling to measure ROI. Rather than seek out productivity or efficiency gains by adding AI capabilities to applications, the AI-UX partnership gives the company's technology strategy a different shape, one, as Nair said in an interview attached to the press release, that starts with outcomes and focuses on where tech can make the biggest difference.

"That requires what I call radical collaboration," Shah said in the interview. "We need product, technology, data and business teams sitting side by side with UX and the people we serve, learning and co-creating together from the beginning."

With Nair's appointment, the company will add to its roster a seasoned retail executive who has spent years working in positions that blend product and technology together, racking up experience at Lowe's, Staples and Gap.

His latest step reflects a broader trend of a combined product and technology position moving up the corporate ladder, a trend that includes Target's Vemana, who was promoted to chief information and product officer last year.

本文最初发表于 CIO Dive。 要接收每日新闻和见解，请订阅我们免费的每日 CIO Dive 时事通讯。

潜水简介：

  • 该公司周二表示，任命 Chandhu Nair 为其首位首席人工智能官兼高级副总裁。 Nair 将于 8 月 24 日加入公司，此前他在 Lowe's 工作了六年多，最近担任商店、数据、人工智能和创新高级副总裁。
  • 该零售商还提拔 Purvi Shah 担任用户体验高级副总裁，并在一份声明中强调，人工智能和用户体验技术之间的紧密关系将有助于其“更快地从洞察转变为行动，同时让人们成为我们构建产品的中心。” 该公司在一封电子邮件中表示，Nair 和 Shah 都将向首席信息和产品官 Prat Vemana 汇报工作。
  • 此次高管变动反映了首席执行官 Michael Fiddelke 于 3 月份推出的多年扭亏为盈战略，以扭转销售放缓的局面。 该计划包括到 2026 年增加 20 亿美元的运营和资本投资，试图重振增长、现代化客户体验并提升品牌形象。

潜水洞察力：

塔吉特正在将人工智能纳入其最高管理层，这表明该技术对其运营战略的重要性。

虽然该公司为新角色赋予了广泛的职权范围，并要求 Nair“在整个企业范围内更加关注和协调人工智能”，但该公司还专注于一个具体的用例：人工智能如何增强用户体验。

当公司仍在努力衡量投资回报率时，这种耦合使塔吉特能够翻转企业实施人工智能的脚本。 AI-UX 合作伙伴关系并没有通过在应用程序中添加人工智能功能来寻求生产力或效率的提高，而是为公司的技术战略提供了一种不同的形态，正如 Nair 在新闻稿所附的采访中所说，这种战略从结果开始，重点关注技术可以发挥最大作用的领域。

“这需要我所说的激进合作，”沙阿在采访中说。 “我们需要产品、技术、数据和业务团队与用户体验和我们服务的人员并肩作战，从一开始就一起学习和共同创造。”

随着 Nair 的任命，该公司将在其名单中增加一位经验丰富的零售高管，他多年来一直在将产品和技术融合在一起的职位上工作，并在 Lowe's、Staples 和 Gap 积累了丰富的经验。

他的最新举措反映了产品和技术职位相结合的公司职位晋升的更广泛趋势，这一趋势包括塔吉特公司的维马纳（Vemana），他去年被提升为首席信息官和产品官。
